documents.title: Acme Corp Employee Handbook 2026
documents.content:
ACME CORP EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK 2026

SECTION 1: PAID TIME OFF (PTO)
All full-time employees receive PTO as follows:
- 0-1 years: 15 days PTO per year
- 1-3 years: 20 days PTO per year
- 3+ years: 25 days PTO per year
PTO accrues monthly and is available immediately upon accrual.
Unused PTO rolls over up to 5 days maximum per year.
PTO over the 5-day rollover limit is forfeited on Dec 31.
Request PTO at least 2 weeks in advance for periods over 3 days.
Emergency PTO requests require manager approval.

SECTION 2: REMOTE WORK POLICY
Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week.
Core hours: 10am-3pm in your local timezone (all employees must be available).
Remote work requires reliable high-speed internet.
Acme Corp reimburses $50/month for home internet costs (submit expense report monthly).
Remote work arrangements must be approved by your direct manager.
New employees: 90-day probation before remote work eligibility.

SECTION 3: EXPENSE REIMBURSEMENT
Home office equipment: Up to $500 one-time allowance for new hires (desk, chair, monitor).
Monthly internet: Up to $50/month reimbursement.
Business travel: Pre-approved travel expenses reimbursed at cost.
Meals during travel: $50/day maximum.
All expenses require receipts and must be submitted within 30 days.
Expense reports submitted via Expensify (link in IT onboarding email).

SECTION 4: SICK LEAVE
10 sick days per year, non-accruing (reset Jan 1).
Sick leave can be used for personal illness, medical appointments, or caring for immediate family.
Doctor's note required for absences exceeding 3 consecutive days.
Unused sick days do not roll over or pay out.

SECTION 5: PARENTAL LEAVE
Primary caregiver: 16 weeks paid parental leave at 100% salary.
Secondary caregiver: 4 weeks paid parental leave at 100% salary.
Must have been employed for 6+ months to qualify.
Parental leave must be taken within 12 months of birth/adoption.

documents.title: Remote Work Guidelines
documents.content:
REMOTE WORK GUIDELINES (Updated Jan 2026)

ELIGIBILITY:
All full-time employees after 90-day probation period.
Contract workers: Not eligible for remote work.
International employees: Subject to local law compliance.

TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENTS:
Company-issued laptop (IT provides).
VPN must be connected during core hours.
Security: Password-protected home WiFi, no public networks during work hours.
Backup: Must have mobile hotspot available as backup connectivity.

HOME OFFICE SETUP:
Dedicated workspace recommended (not a couch or bed).
Adequate lighting for video calls.
Quiet environment during client-facing meetings.

COMMUNICATION:
Slack response expected within 2 hours during core hours (10am-3pm local).
Email response expected within 4 hours during work hours.
Camera on during team meetings (exceptions allowed, notify manager).

documents.title: Benefits Summary 2026
documents.content:
ACME CORP BENEFITS SUMMARY 2026

HEALTH INSURANCE:
Medical: Blue Shield PPO, 100% premium covered for employee, 80% for dependents.
Dental: Delta Dental, 100% premium covered for employee.
Vision: VSP, $200 annual frame allowance.

RETIREMENT:
401(k) with 4% company match (100% vested after 2 years).
Roth 401(k) option available.
Financial planning sessions: 2 free per year with certified planner.

OTHER BENEFITS:
Mental health: 12 free therapy sessions per year via Spring Health.
Learning budget: $1,500/year for courses, conferences, certifications.
Commuter benefits: $315/month pre-tax transit pass.
Gym: $75/month reimbursement for any gym or fitness app.
Employee assistance program (EAP): Free confidential counseling 24/7.
